title: Meet the apple
narration: Meet the apple. Round and smooth, with a stem on top and a shadow on the table. Let's see how it becomes one convincing drawing.

title: 01 · Look first
narration: Before any line, look. A real apple is not a perfect ball. Find the little dip at the top, the lean, the fuller side. That character is what you are really drawing.

title: 02 · Measure and frame
narration: Measure height against width with your pencil. Frame the apple with light 2H lines. These thinking lines keep everything balanced.

title: 03 · Find the light
narration: One light means one highlight and one shadow side. Find the brightest spot first, then the dark band where the surface turns away.

title: 04 · Build the tones
narration: Lay tones from light to dark with the 2B, following the round form. Blend gently with tissue, then deepen with the 3B only where you are sure.

title: 05 · Stem and shadow
narration: The stem and the cast shadow on the table take the darkest accents. Small darks make everything else glow.

title: 06 · Finish
narration: Step back, compare with the real apple, and fix the one thing that matters most. Then sign your name.

title: Your turn
narration: Now it is your turn. One apple, one light, your own hand. I will guide you at every step.
